scope: One six-lane production composition owner before the sole delivery-context registry. It performs immutable association-allocation serialization only; no live read producer, R1 read launch, payload/sidecar deposit, source service, scoreboard event, physical-memory, timing, throughput, PPA, numeric RTL, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE behavior is activated.

module.name: route_a_unified_delivery_context_allocation_bridge
module.selection_rule: existing arrival_ordinal then candidate_id for association serialization only

invariants: A candidate class must match its named lane before allocation.
Registry acknowledgement must echo class, identity, expected fragment count, and target descriptor before ref-bound output.
A bound lane cannot be reused until exact router release.
Top provides inactive read producer inputs and cannot synthesize a candidate.
